notes.title: “Boiling Steel” VR sci-fi shooter from MiroWin launched via Steam
notes.notes:
MiroWin Studio, the developer of the popular Guns’n’Stories: Bulletproof VR, is proud to inform, that their latest VR FPS story-based VR shooter [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1016860/Boiling_Steel/]Boiling Steel[/url][/b] is released in Steam in full version.

[b]The plot[/b]
The story for “Boiling Steel” was written by one of the authors of [b]S.T.A.L.K.E.R.[/b] series. According to the plot you’re one of many who set off in search of a better life in the distant bastion of scientific progress. On the colony planet, free from bureaucratic, religious and other radical restrictions they research and freely use industrial teleportation, transfer of consciousness and other technologies prohibited in the inhabited worlds. Factories, power plants, mines and residential complexes of the planet are fully automated. All the dirty and hard work is done by robotic shells controlled by the operator's mind. It is a high-tech paradise. But here, something went wrong...
Reach the final to know what’s happened.

In the [b]full version you’ll find[/b]:
[list]
[*] 11 tools, each with unique playstyle, upgrades, and handling, including the stripping cutter and PFG (the tool for the pit-stop refueling of the reactive thrusters of the industrial drones)
[*] the fisticuffs
[*] the gravity beam and dynamic objects that can be controlled using this beam.
[*] more than 40 combat missions equaling over 10 hours of action-packed VR shooting goodness.
[*] final part with 10 additional maps and not less than 1 hour of gameplay more.
[*] variety of dynamic interactions with objects
[*] experienced upgrade system. The more you use a tool, the more powerful it becomes. Be rewarded for sticking with a favorite.
[*] non-story missions are randomly generated to make each playthrough exciting and unique.
[*] a wide variety of enemy shells with a multitude of armaments, configurations, and combat style.
[*] overcome planetary security systems such as automated turrets, minefields, energy barriers, and more with smarts, quick reflexes, and puzzle-solving ability.
[*] explore cloud-city complexes, frozen structures, sandy mining platforms, and more.
[/list]

Earlier the free mini-version [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1216220/Boiling_Steel_Preface/]Boiling Steel: Preface[/url] was released on Steam.

[h2]Boiling Steel[/h2]
You are one of many who set off in search of a better life in the distant bastion of scientific progress. Your goal is a colony planet, free from bureaucratic, religious and other radical restrictions.

Factories, power plants, mines and residential complexes of the planet are fully automated. All the dirty and hard work is done by robotic shells controlled by the operator’s mind. It is a high-tech paradise. But here, something went wrong...

[h2]Guns'n'Stories: Bulletproof VR [/h2]
Guns’n’Stories: Bulletproof is a dynamic VR western shooter that fully immerses players into the ambiance of weird Wild West.
Stepping the tangled storyline, you will encounter many intimidating but comical enemies and fight Big Bosses.
You will have to shoot aptly and a lot using both hands as well as to use various covers and move actively, avoiding bullets of enemies.
You will visit many beautiful locations and will be able to try a big arsenal of weapons under the rhythm of the western rock music, jokes, and cynical humor!

With incredible visuals and endless playability, these games will keep you coming back for more!

notes.title: FRESH Update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30284132/82e11a44965327818eda621fb3572a2981c7c50b.jpg[/img]

We are happy to announce a new update for Guns'n'Stories: Bulletproof VR!
Patchnote:
The dynamic was improved and the duration of the 1st and 3rd levels of the 1st Act (1.1.1.3) was reduced. At level 1 of Act 1, now appears Grenadiers with dynamite.
Minor changes in waves at the 2nd level of the 2nd Act (2.2)
The weapon was changed: "Crossbow with Dynamite & Shotgun". Now, dynamite explodes on contact with the enemy, and the shotgun fire range increased, but the rate of fire is reduced.
Added a tutorial when a new weapon is received.
Minor fixes.
Corrected Chinese localization.
Added voice over to the Chinese.
Added localization to German, French, Italian, Spanish, Japanese languages.
Added an encyclopedia with the description of the different types of enemies and bosses.
Added an encyclopedia with the description of the various arsenal of weapon.

Have much fun and lucky shots, cowboys!

notes.title: This day came! The game is launched out of Steam Early Access!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30284132/0b37fe0d8999a2089854ed4eb4a82d47b4955c34.jpg[/img]

Friends!

We love games and want to make a VR-gaming enjoyable and widespread. That is why we wanted to create a simple, fun and dynamic game, in which people could fall out of reality for a short time and get fresh and bright emotions that can be experienced only in childhood. Pure fun!

Our cowboys comes from Hollywood, so they do not waste time for reloading weapons, can dodge bullets and easily deal with hordes fearsome, but invariably comical enemies.
You will not be languish with the boredom and monotony of traditional westerns, because we added to the game an impressive arsenal of firearms, throwing weapons, and even futuristic weapons.
Those of you who will not skip storyline will be able to see in the game more than the "regular wave shooter." (Take advantage of this to take a breath after the heated shootings).
We are sure that you will appreciate the diversity of locations, the jokes of old Bill and the driving soundtrack of the western and blues rock.

Yes, with unaccustomed you can get tired legs, hands and especially your fingers, but  true immersion in another world must to respond to all your senses. Isn't it?
"Mobilis in Mobili"

[b]Since the coming to the Early Access, game has grown up and greatly transformed. We significantly improved the graphics and game mechanics, added new features and game modes.
The story campaign now consists of three chapters and takes place in nine different locations. Players will be able to fight with variety types of enemies and three Bosses, using twelve types of  weapons.


And that's not all!

The official release is marked by a big update, which is adding to the game six different trials - they will opened after the main storyline is completed.
In addition, players can enable/disable the indication of damage and blood.
And at last you can earn achievements, and your skill of passing each level will be appreciated by Sheriff stars!

Also we plan to support and improve the game in the future. [/b]

Good luck in shooting, and stay tuned!

notes.title: The release version of Guns'n'Stories: Bulletproof will be available in March 8!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30284132/486a426a11f139cdf9269952c099aa6b0bad34e1.jpg[/img]


[h1]Friends![/h1] 

We’ve been waiting for this moment for a long time and now we are happy to announce that the development of VR Western Guns'n'Stories: Bulletproof is now on the finish line!

Looking back at the path that we have passed since the advent of the game in Early Access, we see as our project has grown up and we completely understand that we couldn't do this without your feedback and support.

[b] Cabaret:[/b] 
[list]
[*]A hot spot that that may not survive the attack of bandits.

[*]New enemies: Naked giants with hearts over their heads
[/list]
[b] Whiskey Storage:[/b] 
[list]
[*]Our whiskey is under the threat!

[*]New enemies: Drones wearing sombreros.
[/list]
[b] Happy Farm:[/b] 
[list]
[*]You have to protect the Bill's barn with his favorite piggy inside!

[*]New enemies: Bombers with dynamite.
[/list]

[list]
[*]Sweet revenge!

[/list]

[list]

[/list]

[list]

[*]New weapon: Six-barrel machine gun "Best Friend"

[*]Various skins for enemies.

[/list]

notes.title: Road to Release!
notes.notes:
The release of the Third Act of Guns'n'Stories: Bulletproof is behind, which means that now the game has a completed storyline and we have fully fulfilled all the promises to the fans!

Why is the game still in early access, you ask?

It's simple! During the development of the game we collected a lot of feedback from the fans and experimented. There were many ideas.
Some of them we plan to bring into the game for release - in the bonus levels, which will be an additional gratitude for everyone who purchased the game and supported the development of VR-gaming and our work!

Next week we will tell you more about the release version of the game, but for now - a few screenshots from the one of bonus levels!

notes.title: ACT III is out now!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30284132/d3056e1bc43f9b6b272153ab781808420a4b403c.png[/img]

[h1] Friends! [/h1] 

We took one more step on the way to the Final Release and are pleased to announce the release of the Third Act to the VR-western Guns'n'Stories: Bulletproof!

In addition to full-fledged three levels that allow you to investigate Sintown in all its glory, we will make you happy with new cool guns and let you apply them in action.
New enemies and new gaming mechanics will not make you bored as you will have to work really hard!
But the most important thing is that completely re-made and improved graphics is waiting for you along with long-awaited optimization of the gaming process and tips for newcomers!

The next step is the release of The Game, in which we also have something to please you! 
Stay tuned and watch the news!

[b]Details:[/b]
[list]
   [*][b]Three new trials:[/b]
[list]
   [*]Warfare in the Saloon
   [*]Wall to Wall
   [*]Obstacle Race
[/list]

   [*][b]New weapons:[/b] paired Tommy guns “Bella and Talula” and one of our favorites “Mrs. Jumbo”.

   [*][b]New gaming mechanics: [/b]
[list]
   [*]Protection of objects. Whiskey boxes are in jeopardy. Don’t allow to empty them!
   [*]Protection of allies. You lose if all your allies die!
   [*]Chase! A hero is getting teleported to a new town’s location in the final round after each shooting.
[/list]

   [*][b]New types of enemies:[/b]
[list]
   [*]Whiskey Man. He really loves whiskey, especially when it is free.
   [*]Morticians. Don’t let them come too close to you. They are capable of many things in the close combat.
[/list]

   [*][b]A final boss. Harry.[/b]
[list]
   [*]He is a nobleman to the bone. But you should keep your distance!
[/list]

   [*][b]The continuation of a story about good old Bill who always has what to tell ya.[/b]
[/list]
 [*][b]Gameplay and UX[/b]
[list]
 [*]The indicator of the level's progress. Now you will know for sure when you have to cool the heated barrels!
 [*]Support left-handed mode.
[/list]

For those who want to personally try the full attractiveness of the gameplay together with updated graphics before buying a full version - the free version of a game is available for download: Guns’n’Stories: Preface.

[h1] Tell us about your impressions! We always welcome your feedback![/h1]

Hi there, friends!

notes.title: Act II Released!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30284132/fe5e5ec45fe85d9a447bd8dd21d4b02d0fa91650.jpg[/img]

Hey there cowboys!

Do you know what time is it? I bet ya do! Act II is finally released and you can play it right now!

We have three completely new levels to play. Tired of hot and shiny sun? Not a problem cause now it’s night time and you can look on the environment around you with a fresh new look. But don’t feel too relaxed due to the beauty that surrounds you, be aware of new dangers that can kill you in the twinkling of an eye.

The story of the best gunslinger in Sintown continues! Bill is still trying to save his beloved Charlotte. So put on your VR headset and experience all new challenges that Bill encounters in Casper & Jasper Fort. Those who have already played the first Act will be surprised how the game has changed and those who are new to the game will be definitely amazed by what they will see.

You thought Act I was too difficult? Well, we will see what you have to say about this one cause we have prepared three new enemy types that will make you sweat. The battles have never been so tough and in order to survive you need to use your brain and be fast enough with your weapons.

Now to the most interesting part! Weapons. Oh yes, weapons. In Act II you will be able to play with five entirely new weapons. Each one plays absolutely different and has its own strategy. So be ready to experience new gameplay mechanics. After all, this is exactly what every shooter fan is here for, right?

In addition to all of this content you will surely have more damn good jokes from Bill, improving of the overall art style of the game, more balanced difficulty levels and of course a new boss fight at the end.

Do you think you can handle this? Are you still willing to save beautiful ladies of Sintown? Great, then hop on and let’s get started!
